dial.summary: TOTAL crypto rises to $2.96T as Core PCE cooling sparks risk-on rotation — stablecoin dominance falls to 9.8% and alts rally, with BTC.D rolling from 59% toward ~56.5% — but BTC.D has yet to sustain below 55% to confirm Alt Rotation, BTC funding holds near-zero at 0.01% (unlevered spot regime intact), and DXY (101.64) plus real yields (2.90%) sustain macro headwinds; BTC Accumulation posture intact ahead of September NFP (Oct 2) and October CPI (Oct 14) as the defining data for the late-Q4 rate and risk-asset path.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at approximately $103.4T as of October 1, 2026 (MacroMicro/StreetStats aggregation; 6–8 week reporting lag — August 2026 official macromicro reading $103.66T; USD-denominated estimate ~$103.4T after DXY FX drag with dollar at 101.64, +2.1% over 4 weeks); US M2 at $23.3T in August 2026 (+5.7% YoY); 4-week trend flat: no new official global aggregate data since prior reading; YoY still +12% (not contracting); status neutral — rising trend on 4-week basis required for supportive; PCE cooling (August BEA data) is a modest positive but awaiting confirmed G4 expansion; September ISM Manufacturing releases today Oct 1 at 10 AM ET.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: August 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.6%, down 1.0pp from July 55.6% (eighth consecutive month of expansion; released Sep 1); September 2026 ISM Manufacturing releases TODAY October 1 at 10:00 AM ET — after this run at 02:20 UTC; S&P Global Flash US Manufacturing PMI surged to 57.0 (52-month high, released Sep 23) — strong leading signal; consensus for September ISM ~54.8%; 4-week trend down: July 55.6% → August 54.6% = −1.0pp on latest available official data; status neutral (above 50 but falling on 4-week basis; supportive requires above 50 AND rising; headwind requires below 48 or above 62); a September print above 55 and rising would shift status to supportive.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at ~101.64 on October 1, 2026 (up from 101.36 on Sep 29; approaching yearly high near 101.80 per FXStreet; dollar strengthened ahead of ISM and NFP data); 4-week trend up: ~99.60 (Aug 26) → 101.64 (Oct 1) = +2.1% over 4 weeks, well above the 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind — DXY remains above the 100 threshold; a sustained official close below 100 required to return to neutral; September NFP (Oct 2) and October 14 CPI are the next key DXY repricing catalysts.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: FRED DFII10 (10-year TIPS constant maturity) last confirmed at 2.90% as of September 28, 2026 (Sep 24 reading was 2.85%; 10Y nominal rose to 5.29% on Sep 30 from 5.25% Sep 29 per Treasury); breakeven inflation ~2.35% (PCE cooling signal mildly supportive); 4-week trend up: ~2.47% (Aug 28) → 2.90% (Sep 28) = +43bps; status headwind (rising 4-week trend AND above 2% absolute threshold both met); a sustained fall below 2% required to shift status to neutral/supportive; October 27–28 FOMC and October 14 CPI are the next repricing catalysts.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: September 30, 2026: 10Y Treasury at 5.29%, 2Y at 4.91% → 2s10s spread = +0.38% (+38bps); prior Sep 29: +0.36% (+36bps); 4-week trend flat: ~+38bps (Aug 26) → +38bps (Sep 30) = 0bps change, well within the <5bps flat threshold; status neutral (positive spread but flat on 4-week basis; supportive requires BOTH positive AND steepening; deeply inverted < −50bps for headwind does not apply); October 27–28 FOMC and October 14 CPI are the next major repricing catalysts.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,747,704M ($6.75T) for week ending September 23, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 released September 24 (Treasuries $4,558B, MBS $1,910B, other $279B); 4-week trend flat: ~$6.734T (Aug 26) → $6.748T (Sep 23) = +$14B over ~4 weeks, marginal expansion within flat range; total assets up ~$140B year-on-year; status supportive (holding at post-2022 stabilization plateau; no change to QT pace announced at Sep 16 FOMC); next H.4.1 release expected Thursday October 2.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC perpetual funding rate ~0.01% per 8h (near-zero across major exchanges; consistent with unlevered spot-driven regime; convextrade.com confirms 0.01% as of late September 2026); BTC spot ~$83,070 on October 1, 2026, slightly down from $83,517 Sep 30 as alts outperform on risk-on day; TOTAL crypto rising to $2.96T, BTC.D rolling from 59% to ~56.5% as Ethereum and DeFi tokens rally on PCE cooling signal; 30-day funding range consistently sub-0.01% — classic accumulation signal; status supportive (well below 0.04% overheating threshold); October 2 NFP and October 14 CPI are next potential funding regime catalysts.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$291B on October 1, 2026 (down from ~$303B Sep 30; capital rotating into crypto as Core PCE cools); total crypto market cap rising to $2.96T (up from $2.85T Sep 30, +3.9% as Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi rally); stablecoin dominance ~9.8% ($291B / $2.96T); 30-day trend falling: ~10.4% in late August → 9.8% on October 1 = −0.6pp over 30 days; status shifts to supportive (falling dominance on 30-day basis; headwind condition — rising dominance AND rising TOTAL — does not apply); BTC.D rolling from 59% toward ~56.5% as alts outperform; risk-on rotation from stablecoins into crypto assets is a constructive early-alt-cycle signal.

upcoming.title: Employment Situation — September 2026 NFP
upcoming.note: BLS Employment Situation for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — most consequential pre-FOMC data release before the October 27–28 meeting; August NFP was +162K; consensus expects ~175K for September; a reading above +200K with unemployment holding sub-4.5% keeps October hike odds elevated; a miss below +100K could shift the rate path significantly; watch average hourly earnings for wage inflation signals; DXY approaching 101.80 yearly high ahead of this release.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (September 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM Services PMI for September 2026 at 10:00 AM ET — services sector is ~80% of US GDP; released after post-NFP market positioning from October 2 employment data; S&P Global Flash Services PMI for September surged to 58.7 (59-month high) on September 23 — a strong leading signal for ISM Services; a print below 50 alongside a soft NFP would significantly alter the rate-path outlook ahead of October 27–28 FOMC; prior August ISM Services was 54.2%.

upcoming.title: FOMC Minutes (September 15–16, 2026 Meeting)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases minutes of the September 15–16 FOMC meeting at 2:00 PM ET — the meeting at which the Fed raised the fed funds rate by 25bps to 3.75%–4.00%; minutes will reveal debate around the pace of further tightening, the balance between inflation (PCE +3.7% YoY) and growth risks, and any dissents; closely watched for signals on the October 27–28 FOMC decision alongside the full October data cluster (ISM, NFP, CPI); real yields at 2.90% and 2s10s spread at +38bps frame the current conditions.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 3, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for week ending October 3, 2026 — first weekly claims read fully incorporating October's early labor market conditions post-NFP; released the day after FOMC Minutes and ahead of the FOMC blackout period; consecutive claims readings above 225K would signal deterioration; prior weeks approximately 206K; provides a real-time labor read between NFP (Oct 2) and CPI (Oct 14).
